# Spec: ledger-surfaces
<!-- Generated by /hef.spec -->
<!-- Date: 2026-10-02 -->

## Overview

Board items HEF-6, HEF-4 and HEF-5 — the three places the ledger meets a person. **HEF-6**: a person
who ran an item by hand in a `<repo>-feature` pane needs four ledger calls to put it in the release
queue; `ledger.sh handoff <id> --pr <url>` does those four with the same guards. **HEF-4**: the ledger
lives in one checkout's git dir, so the board — the thing every machine and every person reads — says
nothing about where an item is; `ledger.sh publish <id>` mirrors the entry's state to the board item
(a state marker on the kanban heading, or one comment on the GitHub issue). **HEF-5**: a `human:*` block
that nobody notices is the escalation gap report 17 §5d names; `ledger.sh escalate` lists the blocks
older than a threshold as one-line pointers addressed to the pane that owns the kind, and
`/hef.orchestrate` sends each through cross-session messaging once — report 17's single permitted
message type, ≤200 characters, data to the receiver.

Decisions taken here rather than left as clarifications: publish and escalate are **opt-in**
(`orchestrate.publish`, `orchestrate.escalate_after_hours`) — report 17 Phase 2 adds them only where a
person wants the board or the pane to speak; the board write goes through `status-board.sh --mark`, the
one write path the board helper gains, and publish **verifies the item's hash before the write and
re-hashes after it**, so a person's edit is still caught as "changed since claim" while publish's own
marker is not; a state marker coexists with other heading tokens (HEF-10's kind markers) — publish
replaces only markers from its own map; escalate never sends — it lists, the command sends, and
`escalate --record <id>` notes that the pointer went out so the same block is never escalated twice;
the default pane map is shared with the session-start hook and the smoke suite asserts the two copies
are byte-identical.

## User Scenarios

### US1: A hand-run item reaches the release queue in one call [P1]
- **Given** an entry HEF-6 in `implement`, the current checkout on `feature/x`, a PR opened by hand
- **When** `ledger.sh handoff HEF-6 --pr https://github.com/o/r/pull/9` runs in that checkout
- **Then** the ledger records a `run` (role `implement`, exit 0, 0 USD, session `hand`), the PR, the
  branch `feature/x` and the worktree `$PWD`, advances to `pr` and blocks on `human:merge`; it prints
  the entry
- **Edge**: `--branch b` overrides the checkout's branch; an entry in `queued` advances straight to `pr`
- **Error**: the checkout is on `main`, the entry is owned by a session, the entry is already past `pr`,
  or `--pr` is not a pull-request URL, or the entry is blocked (a `human:intake` or `stall` block must not be cleared by a handoff) → non-zero naming the reason, nothing written

### US2: The board shows where an item is [P1]
- **Given** `orchestrate.publish: true`, a tasks-repo board with `## HEF-7 — rename` in TODO.md, and
  HEF-7 blocked on `human:merge` in phase `pr`
- **When** `ledger.sh publish HEF-7` runs
- **Then** the heading becomes `## ⏸ HEF-7 — rename` (the marker for a `human:*` block), the ledger
  re-hashes the item and records `published = {state, at}`; a second publish with no state change
  writes nothing and says so
- **Edge**: the heading already carries a kind marker (`## 🐞 HEF-7 — …`) → `## ⏸ 🐞 HEF-7 — …`; a
  previous state marker is replaced, never stacked; a github-project entry → one `gh issue comment`
  `ledger: HEF-7 phase pr blocked_on human:merge`, only when the state changed
- **Error**: the item's text changed since the hash was taken → refused "changed since claim", the
  board untouched; `orchestrate.publish` absent or false → non-zero "publish is off"; `gh` absent for a
  github-project entry → non-zero naming it

### US3: A block nobody noticed is escalated once, to the pane that owns it [P1]
- **Given** `orchestrate.escalate_after_hours: 4`, HEF-7 blocked on `human:merge` since 5 hours ago,
  HEF-8 blocked on `ci` since 9 hours, HEF-9 blocked on `human:clarify` since 1 hour
- **When** `ledger.sh escalate` runs
- **Then** it prints one line for HEF-7 only — `<session>\tledger HEF-7 blocked_on human:merge <path>`
  where `<session>` is the deploy pane's session name (`orchestrate.pane_sessions.deploy`, default
  `<repo>-deploy`) and `<path>` is the PR URL — and nothing for HEF-8 (`ci` is not a human block) or
  HEF-9 (under the threshold); `escalate --record HEF-7` then marks it, and a second `escalate` omits it
  until the block changes
- **Edge**: the message part is never over 200 characters (a long path is cut and says so)
- **Error**: `escalate_after_hours` absent → non-zero "escalation is off"; a non-numeric value → non-zero
  naming it

### US4: The orchestrator speaks only when configured [P2]
- **Given** `/hef.orchestrate` with publish and escalation configured
- **When** a pass ends
- **Then** it runs `ledger.sh publish <id>` for the entry it touched, then `ledger.sh escalate` and, for
  each line, one cross-session message with exactly the pointer text to the named session, then
  `escalate --record <id>`; with neither configured it does neither and says nothing about them

## Functional Requirements

| ID | Requirement | Priority | Scenario |
|----|-------------|----------|----------|
| FR-001 | `ledger.sh handoff <id> --pr <url> [--branch <b>]`: refuses when the entry is owned, blocked, its phase is past `pr`, the branch (from `--branch` or `git branch --show-current`) is `main`/`master`/empty, or the URL lacks `/pull/<n>`; otherwise records a run (role `implement`, exit 0, usd 0, session name `hand`), `--pr`, `--branch`, `--worktree $PWD`, advances to `pr` (from any earlier phase), blocks on `human:merge`, prints the entry; every write is checked (`|| exit 1`) | P1 | US1 |
| FR-002 | `status-board.sh --mark <id> <marker>` (tasks-repo): rewrites the item's heading in its column file so the first token is `<marker>` (or no marker when `<marker>` is `-`), removing any leading token that is in the publish marker set (`orchestrate.publish_markers` over the default, read by `--mark` itself through the board config) and keeping every other token (kind markers); the heading is found with the board's id-boundary match (`HEF-1` never matches `HEF-10`); the id is validated like `--item`; the search covers todo, doing, backlog and done; exactly one heading changes, atomically (temp + mv); no such item → non-zero; a github-project config → non-zero "use ledger.sh publish" | P1 | US2 |
| FR-003 | `ledger.sh publish <id>`: requires `orchestrate.publish == true`; computes the state — blocked `human:*` → `⏸`, other block → `⛔`, else by phase: `queued` → none, `intake`..`tasks` → `📐`, `implement`..`security` → `🔨`, `pr` → `🔀`, `merged`/`released` → `✅` (overridable by `orchestrate.publish_markers`); no change since `published.state` → prints "unchanged", exit 0; tasks-repo: the item's raw hash must equal `source.body_sha256` when one is stored (else "changed since claim", nothing written), then `status-board.sh --mark`, then re-hash (`record --body-file`); github-project: `gh issue comment <source.url> --body "ledger: <id> phase <p> blocked_on <k|none>"` (gh detected, never installed); then records `published = {state, at}` | P1 | US2 |
| FR-004 | `ledger.sh escalate [--record <id>]`: requires a numeric `orchestrate.escalate_after_hours`; lists every entry blocked on a `human:*` kind for at least that many hours and not yet escalated for this block (`escalated.since != blocked_on.since`), one line `<session>\tledger <id> blocked_on <kind> <path>` — `<session>` from `orchestrate.pane_sessions.<pane>` or `<repo>-<pane>` (`<repo>` = config `name` or the top-level directory name), `<pane>` from the shared kind→pane map (config `orchestrate.panes` over the default), `<path>` by kind — `human:merge` → `pr.url`; `human:clarify`/`human:plan-review` → `question_path`, else `spec_dir`; `human:intake` → `source.ref`; else `-`; the message part (after the tab) ≤200 characters; `--record <id>` writes `escalated = {since: blocked_on.since, at}` | P1 | US3 |
| FR-005 | The default pane map in `ledger.sh` is byte-identical to the one in `session-start-context.sh`, and the default publish marker map in `ledger.sh` is byte-identical to the one in `status-board.sh` (both asserted by smoke) | P1 | US3 |
| FR-006 | `/hef.orchestrate`: on EVERY exit path after pre-flight — including the stops for nothing dispatchable, a `human:intake` block and a failed launch — `ledger.sh publish <id>` when `orchestrate.publish` is true; then, when `orchestrate.escalate_after_hours` is set, `ledger.sh escalate` and for each line one cross-session message (`SendMessage`) to the named session with exactly the text after the tab, then `ledger.sh escalate --record <id>`; a send that fails is reported and not recorded; never any other message | P2 | US4 |
| FR-007 | Docs: `docs/hooks.md` (ledger subcommands; `status-board.sh --mark`), `docs/install.md` §7 (handoff for hand-run items; publish and escalation settings; the attended pane must run with `crossSessionInbound: accept` and `isolatePeerMachines: true` or every pointer fails; the publish glyphs belong in the board's `states` map so the board labels them), README §5 (the four-call sentence becomes `handoff`), `docs/commands.md` orchestrate row, `CHANGELOG.md` (escalation is opt-in; no Phase 1 baseline was measured); board HEF-4/5/6 → DOING | P2 | US1 |

## Success Criteria

| ID | Criterion | Validation Method |
|----|-----------|-------------------|
| SC-001 | handoff: happy path writes run/pr/branch/worktree/phase/block; each refusal (owned, past pr, main, bad URL) leaves the entry byte-identical; mutations on two guards red | `tests/smoke.sh` |
| SC-002 | publish on a fixture board: marker written, kind marker kept, previous state marker replaced, second publish "unchanged", edited item refused with the board untouched, publish off refused, re-hash makes the launcher's changed-since-claim check pass; github-project path on a fake `gh` (one comment, none when unchanged); mutations on the hash check and the replace-not-stack rule red | `tests/smoke.sh` |
| SC-003 | escalate: threshold, human-only, recorded-once, session naming default and override, 200-char cap; the two pane maps identical; mutations on the threshold and the record filter red | `tests/smoke.sh` |
| SC-004 | `bash tests/smoke.sh` green; doc counts unchanged (no new command, hook or speckit subcommand) | CI |
